actual_scope: For four registers and the fixed torsion-free rational address alphabet {A,B,P,Q}, determine the exact paid-call minimum for diag([A+P],[A+Q],[B+P],[B+Q]) under all rank-one idempotents N in M4(F2) and arbitrary word order.
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scope selection, exact cost screening, derivation, verifier implementation, overlap review, and package writing.
author: Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337)
bottleneck_link: A four-role bit-side call reduction could affect the bit primitive, but the pinned selected baseline says the complex primitive still binds. This target has exact minimum eight and makes no supplier or kappa claim.
evidence: For the exact target masks P_A=diag(1,0,0,1), P_B=diag(0,1,1,0), and P_P=I4, every word induces sums S_A+S_Q=P_A, S_B+S_Q=P_B, S_P+S_Q=P_P. A sum S of m rank-one idempotents satisfies rank(S)<=m and tr(S)=m mod 2, so m>=rank(S)+((rank(S)-tr(S)) mod 2). Exact minimization of the resulting sum over all 65,536 S_Q gives eight. Four target roles each directly use two of {A,B,P,Q}, giving an exact eight-call word. Therefore the target has exact paid-call minimum eight in this fixed alphabet, for all word lengths.

open_questions.blocked_by: An added address can change the free abelian lattice and derivative coordinates; the present three-variable certificate cannot be reused without recomputing that lattice.
open_questions.first_step: Parameterize a bounded rational family R_t=(1,t)^T(1,t), express each R_t in the A,B,P frame span, derive the integral address lattice with R_t included, and compute the exact rank/trace first-order floor before any full-word search.
open_questions.question: Can adding one further rational rank-one frame in the symmetric span of A,B,P lower the exact first-order floor for this target?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The current exact minimum depends on the four-address alphabet; a fifth legal product is the smallest extension that may break the call floor without changing the four target outputs.

scope_change_reason: The card allows a fixed larger register count. This fixes W=4, replaces the prior W=3 operation domain with four explicit rational rank-one bilinear frames satisfying Q=A+B-P, and tests one four-output rank-two target whose direct word uses only those legal addresses. The source frames are actual rational rank-one products, not finite-torsion labels.
stop_rule: Stop after deriving the J/J^2 equations, exactly minimizing the rank/trace lower bound over every S_Q in M4(F2), verifying the direct eight-call word, and running the parity-mask control. The bound applies to words of every length; do not expand the address alphabet or claim a kappa.
